e1.speaker: envoy_fox
e1.text: Ahh, the Master's little blade. How sharp you've grown. We are his eyes on this shore.

e2.speaker: envoy_fox
e2.text: The villagers will weep at you. Weeping is a trick. Shall I teach you how to stop hearing it?

choices.text: I'll listen to whoever I want.
Why do you wear a mask, fox?

e_obey.speaker: envoy_fox
e_obey.text: Good. Think only of the Master's warmth. ...Do you feel it? No? You will.

e_defy.speaker: envoy_fox
e_defy.text: Hmm. The Master will be... interested to hear that.

e_mask.speaker: envoy_fox
e_mask.text: So the light does not see us, little blade. The light remembers faces. Run along.

strays.speaker: envoy_fox
strays.text: Feeding strays and hunting drowned fathers? The Master did not send you to be kind, little blade. Kindness leaks.

again.speaker: envoy_fox
again.text: Go on. Your target waits past the south-eastern gates. Follow the sound of the surf.

post.speaker: envoy_fox
post.text: Beautifully done. The Master's hands are warmer already. ...Don't look at the water, little blade. It's only rising.
